items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: Well Tiola went down with us. OH, TIOLA WENT DOWN WITH YOU. Yeah, he was with us.

ctx.x: WHEN DID YOU HEAR ABOUT IT?
I got a letter from him.

FROM HIM, NO KIDDING.
And he left for Sheffield.
HIS FAMILY, I THOUGHT EVERYBODY HATED HIM. HIS FAMILY TAKE HIM IN, SOMEBODY TRIED TO CALL HIS WIFE OUT IN BAKERSFIELD, SHE DIDN'T WANT TO KNOW ABOUT HIM. HIS WIFE AND DAUGHTER SAID THEY WERE GLAD TO GET RID OF HIM.
